cards.ex: The board of directors is in complete accord regarding the new marketing strategy.
cards.exUz: Direktorlar kengashi yangi marketing strategiyasi bo'yicha to'liq kelishuvda.
cards.uzDef: To'liq rozi bo'lish, fikrlashishda bir xillikka erishish.

cards.ex: The company decided to embrace the idea of remote work after the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pandemiya davridan keyin masofadan ishlash g'oyasini qabul qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi fikrni iliqlik bilan qabul qilish va qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: There was only one dissenting voice in the committee's decision.
cards.exUz: Qo'mita qarorida faqat bitta qarshi ovoz bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan farqli fikr bildiradigan odam.

cards.ex: His behavior is often at odds with the company's values.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakatlari ko'pincha kompaniyaning qadriyatlariga zid keladi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan kelishmaslik, zid bo'lish.

cards.ex: While most supported the proposal, she held a different view.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik taklifni qo'llab-quvvatlagan bo'lsa-da, u boshqa fikrda edi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odamlardan farqli fikrga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I don't support censorship on principle.
cards.exUz: Men qoidalarga ko'ra senzuraning tarafdori emasman.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum qoidalarga yoki e'tiqodga asoslanib.

cards.ex: They fell out with each other over a business deal.
cards.exUz: Ular biznes kelishuvi sababli bir-birlari bilan janjallashib qolishdi.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir janjallashib, munosabatlarni buzish.

cards.ex: Losing the contract was a hard pill to swallow for the company.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yo'qotish kompaniya uchun og'ir haqiqat edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan noxush haqiqat.

cards.ex: The two leaders are in total disagreement on climate change policy.
cards.exUz: Ikki rahbar iqlim o'zgarishi siyosati bo'yicha to'liq kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday fikrda bir xillik yo'q, mutlaqo kelishmaslik.

cards.ex: The team needs to sing from the same hymn sheet if they want to win.
cards.exUz: Agar jamoa g'alaba qozonmoqchi bo'lsa, bir xil fikrda bo'lishi kerak.
cards.term: sing from the same hymn sheet
cards.uzDef: Hammasi bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir xil maqsadga erishishga intilish.

cards.ex: Their political views are worlds apart.
cards.exUz: Ularning siyosiy qarashlari olam-olam farq qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Judayam farq qiladigan, o'xshashligi yo'q.

cards.ex: I take exception to your accusations.
cards.exUz: Men sizning ayblovlaringizga qarshi chiqaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga norozilik bildirish, rozi bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: The debate featured opposing viewpoints on the issue.
cards.exUz: Munozarada masala bo'yicha qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazarlar namoyish etildi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga zid bo'lgan, kelishish imkoni yo'q bo'lgan qarashlar.

cards.ex: We need to stand shoulder to shoulder to fight for our rights.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z huquqlarimiz uchun kurashish uchun yelka berib turishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda bir maqsad uchun kurashish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: He always toes the party line, no matter what he thinks.
cards.exUz: U nima deb o'ylamasin, har doim partiya yo'lini ushlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Guruhning rasmiy siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: We'll just have to agree to differ on this matter.
cards.exUz: Biz bu masala bo'yicha farqli fikrga rozi bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelisha olmaslikni tan olish va bahslashmaslikka kelishish.

cards.ex: It's time for them to bury the hatchet and move on.
cards.exUz: Ularning urushni to'xtatib, oldinga siljish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq davom etgan janjalni to'xtatish, yarashish.

cards.ex: They don't see eye to eye on most things.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'p narsalarda bir xil fikrda emaslar.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lmaslik, kelishmaslik.

cards.ex: Let's try to meet each other halfway and find a solution.
cards.exUz: Keling, bir-birimizga yarim yo'lda uchrashishga harakat qilaylik va yechim topaylik.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilikda bir-biringizga yon berish.

cards.ex: I have some reservations about the plan.
cards.exUz: Mening reja haqida ba'zi shubhalarim bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga nisbatan shubhalar yoki xavotirlar mavjudligi.

cards.ex: The two countries are at odds over trade policy.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat savdo siyosati bo'yicha kelishmaslikda.
cards.uzDef: Qarama-qarshi bo'lish, kelishmovchilikda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The government is taking a hard line on immigration.
cards.exUz: Hukumat immigratsiya bo'yicha qattiq pozitsiyani egallamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror masalada qat'iy va murosasiz pozitsiyani egallash.

cards.ex: Losing the election was a hard pill to swallow for the candidate.
cards.exUz: Saylovda mag'lubiyatga uchrash nomzod uchun og'ir qabul qilish edi.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan haqiqat yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: I agree wholeheartedly with your assessment of the situation.
cards.exUz: Men sizning vaziyatni baholashingizga to'liq roziman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa bilan to'liq va hech qanday shubhasiz rozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: The reporter was really sticking to point during the interview with the senator.
cards.exUz: Senator bilan suhbat davomida muxbir haqiqatan ham nuqtaga yopishib oldi.
cards.uzDef: biron bir fikrga sodiq qolish, uni qat'iyat bilan himoya qilish

cards.ex: I have reservations about the plan, but I'm willing to give it a try.
cards.exUz: Mening rejaga nisbatan shubhalarim bor, lekin men uni sinab ko'rishga tayyorman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida shubhalar yoki xavotirlar mavjud bo'lish

cards.ex: They always quibble over the smallest details; it's exhausting.
cards.exUz: Ular har doim eng kichik detallar ustida bahslashishadi; bu juda charchatadi.
cards.uzDef: Mayda narsalar ustida janjallashmoq yoki tortishmoq.

cards.ex: Let's sit down and iron out our differences before the project begins.
cards.exUz: Keling, loyiha boshlanishidan oldin o'tirib, kelishmovchiliklarimizni hal qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni hal qilmoq, murosaga kelmoq.

cards.ex: There's a huge gulf between their political ideologies.
cards.exUz: Ularning siyosiy mafkuralari o'rtasida katta tafovut bor.
cards.uzDef: O'rtada katta farq yoki kelishmovchilik borligi.

cards.ex: The protesters marched in defiance of the government's orders.
cards.exUz: Noyishchilar hukumat buyruqlariga qarshi yurish qildilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga zid ravishda harakat qilish.
